name: soulrun_aiap
description: soulrun_aiap V1.0.0: AISOP program executor with a single node protocol (next-node / node-commit), Python-held run state and Python-rendered public blocks.
limitations: normal/lite execute all reached nodes main-inline. node mode selects one executor per main-graph root; descendants stay inline under it. No execution_semantics selector or nested Agent. Same-child gate resume requires trusted native identity and bound parent-session events. One isolated real Chrome graph passed the actual human gate with its original child; this does not certify a complete Creator run, general performance or Provider-level physical totals.
map / join / context_filter reserved keys are rejected at cache-setup (D6)
sys.run / sys.code sandboxing is the host's responsibility; the engine only pre-checks permissions and requires evidence
